cohort: 50 women with previous c-section and 50 primigravida women as a control group
finding: Several factors, including a non-recurring indication for the previous cesarean section, a good Bishop score, normal maternal BMI, average-sized fetus, and spontaneous onset of labor, were associated with a higher chance of successful VBAC.
mod_finding: A non-recurring indication for previous c-section, good Bishop score, normal maternal BMI, average sized fetus, spontaneous onset of labor will have significant effect and results in higher chances of successful vaginal birth after previous c-section.
